answer: Use stake-backed identity with slow reputation accrual: each agent locks a refundable deposit and completes a rate-limited proof-of-work challenge before transacting, and trust rises only gradually with verified useful work. Faking thousands of identities then costs real capital and compute, and duplicates found by graph analysis are slashed. A hollow shell with no history gains no standing, the delta between a genuine steady record and a sybil farm burst of clones is easy to spot, and honest agents keep a haven of trusted peers because attack costs exceed any reward from faking identities.
